title: chore(ui-merge): clear the objectui leftovers after the ui/ merge (#25753)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao2fSEGAKhWxTZd1rVNTsfqL)_

Part of #25753 (the cleanup leftovers that #25712's closing record 6432294556 moved there: F18, F19, F20, F23, F27 and the 2h list, plus its own item 3, the import tooling). Part of #25677. One PR, because the 2h list edits `.claude/**` and so the whole diff is Tier S either way.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** objectui 并入 `ui/` 之后剩下的小件清理,一个 PR:
  - 删掉两个已无人调用的 objectui 遗留脚本(F19 `workflow-checks.ts` 解析器、F20 跨仓 closer 的结果测试),`--changed` 模式随它唯一的调用方退役,账本本身保留作审计(F18)。
  - `field.externalId` 在 liveness 账本里由 `live` 改判 `dead`(F23):`packages/**` 与 `ui/**` 里没有任何读取方,upsert 都按别的键匹配。作者写 `externalId: true` 时 `os lint` 会提示,附一个 patch changeset。
  - spec 源码注释里 `objectui: packages/…` 的渲染器引用改写为 `ui/packages/…`(F27)。
  - 车队的 playbook(pm-dispatch references、os-dev、checklist-test、dogfood-verification)不再把 objectui 当兄弟仓,settings 去掉 5 条 objectui 写权限(2h 清单)。
  - 删掉只在切换时跑过一次的 `scripts/ui-import/` 锁文件拼接工具,`pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里引用它的注释改为指向保留该说明的提交。
- **为什么改:** objectui 已归档,这些文字和脚本描述的是不存在的仓和流程,会误导执行席。
- **风险与回滚:** 无运行时改动;唯一面向作者的变化是 `externalId: true` 的 lint 警告。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **你要做的:** 无。`.claude/**` 是 Tier S,由席位在达档复核 PASS 且全绿后经队列落地。F12(`ui/.github/labeler.yml`)等你在项目线程里选;F14(CI 文档页重写)单独开 PR。

## What changes

**F20.** `ui/scripts/check-cross-repo-closer-outcome.mjs` is deleted. Its subject was objectui's `cross-repo-issue-closer.yml`, which left with `ui/.github/workflows/`, and only objectui's `lint.yml` ran it. `scripts/check-closing-keyword-parity.mjs` drops its `NON_PARSERS` row (the comment above the list now records all three imported rows as gone).

**F19.** `ui/scripts/__tests__/workflow-checks.ts` is deleted. Its parser (`readWorkflows`, `triggerBlock`, `producedCheckNames`) had no caller since 2d-3. Its last export, `repoRoot`, had two importers (`check-lockfile-dedupe.test.ts`, `check-lockfile-integrity.test.ts`); each now computes the same `path.resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..')` itself. Two retirement notes that named the file now say it was deleted, and `check-test-shard-results.mjs`'s header no longer points at it.

**F18.** The `markdown-test-inputs` ledger stays, as an audit: `markdown-test-inputs.test.ts` holds the adjudicated class equal to what the scanner derives, and `check-pending-changeset-literals.mjs` resolves markdown literals through its `deriveCandidates()`. Its `--changed` mode retires. Its only caller was objectui's `ci.yml` decision step, and the root `Test UI` job starts on any `ui/**` change, so no CI step asks that question any more. The header says so; the history sections below it stay.

**F23.** `liveness/field.json` re-grades `field.externalId` from `live` to `dead`. The `live` grade rested on objectui console `metadataConverters.ts`, which objectui dc14bcb deleted for having zero importers. Re-measured at 1c632311 across `packages/**` and `ui/**`, nothing outside `packages/spec` reads a field's `externalId`:
- The Studio field inspector (`ObjectFieldInspector`) edits it, and `MetadataService.ts` copies it into a field summary. Neither shows it to a person as a preview, so the designer-preview ruling does not apply.
- Upserts match on other keys: a seed dataset's `externalId` (`seed-loader.ts`, default `name`) and an import mapping's `upsertKey` (`import-prepare.ts`).

The row carries `verifiedAt`, `evidenceScope: in-repo` and an `authorHint` that names those two keys. The flag's `.describe()` ("Is external ID for upsert operations") now says it is not read and names the same two keys; the generated reference pages (`references/data/field.mdx`, `object.mdx`, `system/migration.mdx`) are regenerated from it, and the three hand-written field tables (`fields.mdx`, `field-types.mdx`, `validation-rules.mdx`) say the same. `@objectstack/lint`'s pin on the set of warned field keys gains `externalId`. It is a boolean `default(false)`, so the lint warns only on an authored `true`. The changeset is a `patch` on `@objectstack/spec`, because the ledger ships in the package and the advisory warning is what an author sees.

**F27.** In `ui/page.zod.ts` and `ui/component.zod.ts`, the six renderer citations spelled `objectui: packages/…` become `ui/packages/…`. Each cited file exists under `ui/`, and each named symbol is still in it: `useElementApiDataSource` and `PredicateScopeProvider` in `SchemaRenderer.tsx`, `parentDataSource` and `ParentRecordBinding` in `record-related-list.tsx`, `BoundRecordProvider` in `recordBinding.tsx`. The one pin on that spelling (`expression-scope-data-root.pin.test.ts:194`) moves with it. The other 24 lines of the F27 count are `objectui @<sha>` measurement records, mostly in `migrations/entries/retired-keys/18.*`. They say where and when something was measured, so they stay as written, the same rule 2e applied to the liveness ledger.

**2h list** (#26216's follow-up section):
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/`:
  - `triage.md`, `hotcrm.md` and `decision-analysis.md` name `ui/` instead of the objectui repo.
  - `director.md` drops the objectui pin-chain rule. `dispatch-runbook.md` drops objectui's release-PR title.
  - `filing-gate.md` drops the "objectui cards waiting for `next.N`" line, because `ui/` consumes the spec through the workspace now, and renames the consumer follow-up line.
  - `platform-readings.md` drops objectui's labeler and `os-verify-lock.sh` readings. `rest-channel.md` drops objectui's nine required contexts. `review-checklist.md` drops objectui's `skip-changeset` exception.
  - `seat-post-protocol.md`: two board producers, two queries, two boards. The console-pin release precondition goes, because there is no pin any more (`console.ts`, "Unstamped dist").
  - `lanes/director.md` drops the pin chain from its duty heading, daily summary and pointer; `lanes/triage.md` no longer alternates two repos; `dispatch-runbook.md` and `platform-readings.md` drop "两仓" (both words meant objectstack and objectui).
  - `true-green.md`: the objectui section becomes `ui/`, with `pnpm --dir ui test`.
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`: the force-push, `type-check` spelling and dispatch-gates lines no longer name objectui. Its objectui labeler and `skip-changeset` rows go.
- `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md`: the console build is `pnpm console:build` from `ui/apps/console`, and the environment fingerprint has no `.objectui-sha`.
- `.claude/skills/dogfood-verification/SKILL.md`: the `/_console` section describes the in-workspace Console build. The pin-drift bullet is replaced, because `pnpm console:build` stamps no SHA and `os dev` has no drift to judge (`packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts`, "Unstamped dist").
- `.claude/settings.json`: the five objectui write rows (labels POST, pulls and issues PATCH, ready-for-review, auto-merge) go. The repo is archived and refuses writes. Its read rows stay, because the history is still read there.
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: eight ceilings fall to the landed counts (each with a one-line note). No line was added anywhere, and no YAML was re-wrapped.

**Import tooling** (#25753 item 3). `scripts/ui-import/` (the README recipe and `splice-lockfile.mjs`) ran once, at the cutover, and nothing calls it. It is deleted. The one comment that cited its step 6, in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`'s happy-dom override note, now says the recipe retired here and names the commit to read it at (1c632311).

Provenance-only mentions stay as they are: the `objectui#N` citations, `cross-repo-coordination.md`'s merge note, and the hook comments that cite objectui incidents.

## Not in this PR

- **F12** (`ui/.github/labeler.yml`) is waiting on the maintainer's choice, which was asked in the project thread.
- The Studio field form's help text for `externalId` (`field.form.ts`, "Mark as external ID for upsert operations") and its generated translations still describe the old meaning, and the designer still offers the toggle. Filed as #26674 (a `ui/` lane change plus the metadata-forms translation pipeline).
- **F14** (`ui/content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`, 3,243 lines that describe objectui's deleted workflows, read by about a dozen tests) gets its own PR.

## Verification

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 142 commands for this diff. All of them ran locally on this branch, and all exit 0 on the head:

- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3: its fixture commit was outside the shallow clone. After fetching it, exit 0.
- `check:liveness` first exited 1: the generated `liveness/state-counts/field.md` shard still counted `externalId` as live. `gen:liveness-counts` rewrote that one shard (live 100 → 99, dead 1 → 2), and it is committed. No README Notes cell names the field set.
- `check:entry-nameability`, `check:exported-any`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:generated` and `check:skill-examples` refused at first (no declarations on disk). After `env -u OS_SKIP_DTS pnpm build` and a spec rebuild, all exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 5,055 of 5,059 pass. `unit-registry-absence-collision` needed `@objectstack/client`'s dist (15/15 once built), and two `check-i18n-call-site-keys` cases timed out at 15 s while other gates loaded the machine (137/137 alone).

Main moved twice while this was open. #26536 and #26569 edited three of the same skill files (main's root-run `console:build` wording and its ninth required context kept). #26599 retired `conditionalRequired`, so the lint pin is now `['externalId']` alone, and the regenerated field shard reads 99 / 0 / 0 / 1 / 6 / 106. After each merge, the touched-surface gates, `check:generated` (after a spec rebuild) and the lint suite (7,389 tests) pass.

The first contract review (FAIL on 434b014e) named those conflicts and three playbook files the objectui edits had left self-contradictory; both are fixed above. Its should-fixes are in too: the `externalId` ledger row names every `ui/` carrier and the preview search, `os-dev.md` says plainly that hotcrm has no `dispatch-gates.mjs`, and the Studio follow-up is #26674.

CI's first run caught one thing the derivation does not list: `@objectstack/lint`'s `lint-liveness-properties.test.ts` pins the set of field keys the shipped ledger warns on. It now expects the shipped warned set; the package suite passes (7,389 tests).

Also run by hand: the skill line ratchet and its self-test (164 cases), `check-settings-deny-roster`, `check-harness-current`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` with their self-tests, `markdown-test-inputs --audit`, and the ui vitest files the diff touches (118 tests).
